name: # Haiku sweep 2026-10-08. Prices/terms are as shown in search snippets or single page fetches
kind: NOT verified; Atlas reads the real terms. fit_1to5 = sweep's rough judgement vs the six needs in docs/claude/DEN-REQUEST-dog-generators-2026-10-08.md.

name: Infinigen (princeton-vl)
what_it_makes: Nature/creature generators; scout/12 found wolf NURBS body+head templates and Blender fur groom code in source (the Haiku sweep's fetched docs named no canine generator; the source read in scout/12 did)
rig_animation: 'Articulated' sim assets mentioned; rig unverified; exports OBJ/OpenUSD
notes: Cleanest licence of all candidates. Spark is assigned the hands-on run (request file). Verdict waits on Spark's renders.

name: SMAL (MPI-IS)
what_it_makes: Quadruped mesh from shape+pose params, learned from toy-figurine scans; dog in species list, wolf not
rig_animation: pose params drive skinned mesh; no game-ready armature
licence_terms_summary: PS:License 1.0 — non-commercial (already ruled out by Spark 01/Scout 12)
notes: Known dead end for a sold game; reference only.

name: BARC / BITE (D-SMAL)
kind: research dog body model on SMAL
notes: Known dead end (Spark 01); reference only.

name: Rigify (built into Blender)
kind: free rigging add-on, Wolf + Basic Quadruped meta-rigs
what_it_makes: Rig for a body you model; no body generation
rig_animation: generated FK/IK rig from meta-rig; gaits not included
licence_terms_summary: bundled with Blender (GPL tool; rigs/output ours)
notes: Rig + attachment points on OUR mesh; pairs with the Stark-derived body. No breeds, no art.

name: Animal Rigger Pro (Superhive)
kind: paid Blender add-on, rigs a quadruped mesh you supply
what_it_makes: Dog/wolf/fox rig from side-view landmarks on your mesh
rig_animation: generated armature, animatable without the add-on; FBX/glTF export
licence_terms_summary: FAQ says GPL; whether rig OUTPUT is covered unchecked
notes: v0.1, Blender 5.1+, Linux untested. Landmark-driven fits our pipeline. Output-licence question for Atlas.

name: Auto-Rig Pro (Superhive)
what_it_makes: Rig for your own mesh; quadruped in core
rig_animation: quad rig; reviewer complains about toe joints
notes: Mature but still needs our mesh and art.

name: IK Dynamic (Blender)
what_it_makes: Gait/locomotion on an existing rig; no body
notes: Walk only; trot/gallop unverified.

name: Creature Kitbash: Beastly Bits
notes: Dead end.

name: # --- commercial figure systems and asset packs ---
Daz Dog 8 (+ Phenotypes, breed morphs)
what_it_makes: Quadruped dog base; Phenotypes pack = 63 construction morphs for many dog types; renders to 2D
rig_animation: Daz rig; trot aniBlocks and pose packs sold separately
licence_terms_summary: Standard EULA reportedly covers 2D RENDERS you own (sprites); Interactive License needed only to ship 3D content in-game — the deciding question for Atlas
cost: $25.95 base; morph packs extra; Interactive License price unconfirmed (forum: $10-50 per product)
notes: Strongest many-breeds-from-one-source if the 2D-render reading holds: we render side views and restyle to flat two-tone. Needs Daz account + purchase (GrumpyDingo).

name: Dog Character and Animation Pack (Fab)
what_it_makes: 20 dog breeds (Beagle, Border Collie, GSD, Husky, St Bernard, African Wild Dog...) on ONE shared skeleton
licence_terms_summary: Fab licence not shown in search; Atlas to read
notes: Shared skeleton = gear attaches once; breed = mesh swap. Would be a render-to-2D source. Fab account needed (GrumpyDingo).

name: Polygon Dog Pack (Synty)
licence_terms_summary: Unity Asset Store EULA / Synty EULA not read
notes: Recognisable Synty look — must restyle hard. Unity account needed.

name: Cartoon Dogs Pack (Unity 163901)
licence_terms_summary: Unity Asset Store EULA; not read
notes: Broadest Unity breed count.

name: Simple Dogs - Cartoon Animals (Unity 82665)
rig_animation: idle/walk/run/sit/lie etc.; no trot or gallop listed
licence_terms_summary: Unity Asset Store EULA; not read
notes: Cheap; missing gaits we need.

name: Game Ready Rigged Wolf (Superhive)
notes: Single species; cheap rig test.

name: Dog Collection Pack (CGTrader)
notes: No animations.

name: Reallusion Character Creator (Stylized Animals)
what_it_makes: Stylized animals; CC has no native quadruped base
notes: Dead end: no quadruped base.

name: Tripo (tripo3d.ai)
rig_animation: Rigging v2.5: QUADRUPED auto-rig + retarget; vendor says dogs/cats/horses rig most reliably
licence_terms_summary: conflicting: free tier CC BY vs non-commercial by source; paid = private + commercial per vendor blog — Atlas to read ToS
notes: Best-documented quadruped auto-rig of the SaaS set, vendor claims only. Account needed (GrumpyDingo).

name: Meshy
what_it_makes: textured 3D meshes; no dog-quality evidence found
licence_terms_summary: official page fetched: Free = CC BY 4.0 commercial-with-attribution, user owns output; Pro = private, full commercial
notes: Clearest licence wording of the SaaS set. Account needed.

name: Rodin (Hyper3D/Deemos)
licence_terms_summary: output-rights clause not retrieved; paid plans reportedly commercial
notes: Pay-per-download; terms unread. Account needed.

name: Luma Genie
licence_terms_summary: commercial rights tied to active subscription; free = non-commercial
notes: Subscription-bound rights: poor fit.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.x (Tencent)
licence_terms_summary: community licence EXCLUDES EU/UK/South Korea; MAU cap
notes: Geographic exclusion blocks selling the game there. Dead end.

name: TRELLIS (Microsoft)
notes: Shape source only; retopo+rig+restyle ourselves. Known from Spark 01.

name: TripoSR (Stability/Tripo)
notes: Blockouts only. Known from Spark 01.

name: Stable Fast 3D (Stability)
what_it_makes: image to textured mesh with UVs
licence_terms_summary: Stability Community License: free under $1M revenue; gated HF login
notes: Needs HF account + contact share (GrumpyDingo).

name: Sloyd / Spline AI / Alpha3D / Kaedim
what_it_makes: parametric or image-to-3D; NO dog/quadruped evidence found for any
notes: No creature evidence; sales-led; dead ends for now.

name: Spine (Esoteric Software)
kind: 2D skeletal rig tool (paid editor, proprietary runtimes)
what_it_makes: Bone+mesh 2D skeletal animation; you author the dog; attachments on bones = gear points; Pixi runtime exists
rig_animation: bones, IK + meshes (Professional only); all our gaits doable
licence_terms_summary: per-person editor licence; runtimes usable only with valid editor licence; Enterprise required at $500k+ revenue ($2,499 + $379/user/yr)
cost: Essential $99/$69 sale (no meshes/IK export); Professional $449/$379 sale
notes: Strongest 2D rig fit (gear attachment, IK, Pixi runtime). It is a TOOL: breeds and art are still ours. Purchase = GrumpyDingo.

name: Rive
kind: vector animation tool (free editor, MIT runtimes)
rig_animation: bones, mesh deformation, state machines; quadruped workflow less proven
licence_terms_summary: MIT runtimes, no runtime fee; paid seat to ship .riv exports
notes: Cleanest licence of the commercial 2D tools; vector fits our SVG style. Less proven for quadruped gaits.

name: DragonBones
what_it_makes: bones, slots, meshes, FFD; Pixi/Phaser runtimes
licence_terms_summary: MIT-listed; VERIFY repo LICENSE; project appears unmaintained/dead download
notes: Fallback if Spine cost blocks; maintenance risk.

name: Live2D Cubism
licence_terms_summary: subscription only; business tier by company revenue
notes: Poor fit for quadruped gaits. Dead end.

name: Creature (Kestrel Moon)
licence_terms_summary: runtimes Apache-2.0 per third-party coverage (verify); editor paid
notes: Activity and price unclear.

name: Spriter Pro (BrashMonkey)
what_it_makes: bone hierarchy + sprite parts; no IK
notes: Old, no IK.

licence_terms_summary: commercial game use OK, no redistribution (listing)

notes: Needs sign-up to test (GrumpyDingo list).

name: BitsyPet (tekengine)

name: The Sims 3 Create-a-Pet
what_it_makes: breed-like shapes blended with sliders on one base body
notes: One base + sliders, breeds are presets.

name: The Sims 4 breed system (125 breeds)
what_it_makes: breed presets (head/ears/nose/eyes) + sculpt sliders + Breed Mixer
notes: Morph mechanism unconfirmed.

name: Sims pet bone-delta sliders (Mod The Sims)
what_it_makes: sliders as per-bone offsets on one skeleton
notes: Closest analogue to our joint-data rig. Lesson: clamp slider ranges; test extremes.

what_it_makes: many breeds grouped by pattern/colour; ~4 shepherd sub-types
rig_animation: cat reused dog model as a hack and broke behaviour
notes: Species behaviour is its own work, not a skin swap.
